name: Datadog
label: Datadog HTTP API
description: Datadog HTTP API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/. Host https://api.{site} (config site, default datadoghq.com). Auth: DD-API-KEY (api_key) and DD-APPLICATION-KEY (app_key). downtime_schedule and incident_create take purpose-oriented JSON:API fields (scope, title, customer_impacted, …) nested via bodyMap; `data` remains an escape hatch. listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message event.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. downtime_schedule takes scope/message/monitor_id/monitor_tags/schedule. incident_create takes title/customer_impacted/fields. Do not put api_key or app_key here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official Datadog call to run. EXACT: metric_submit | event_post | monitor_get | monitor_list | monitor_mute | downtime_schedule | incident_create | incident_get | log_search | listen. monitor_mute is deprecated; prefer downtime_schedule. listen is ingress (BPMN message event). Example: event_post.

schema.label: monitor_id
schema.description: Monitor id. Path for monitor_get / monitor_mute. downtime_schedule: nests as data.attributes.monitor_identifier.monitor_id (alternative to monitor_tags). Example: 123456.

schema.label: incident_id
schema.description: Incident UUID for incident_get path. Example: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

schema.label: series
schema.description: metric_submit official v2 body `series`: list of {metric, type, points[[ts,value]], tags, resources}. Docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/metrics/ Example: [{"metric":"app.latency","type":3,"points":[[1710000000,12]]}].

schema.label: title
schema.description: event_post: event title (required). incident_create: data.attributes.title (required). Example: Checkout 5xx spike.

schema.label: text
schema.description: event_post body `text` (required). Event message body. Example: p95 latency 2.4s.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: event_post body `tags` (comma-separated or JSON array). monitor_list query `tags`. Example: env:prod,service:checkout.

schema.label: alert_type
schema.description: event_post body `alert_type`. EXACT: error | warning | info | success | user_update | recommendation | snapshot. Example: error.

schema.label: name
schema.description: monitor_list query `name` filter (substring). Example: checkout latency.

schema.label: page
schema.description: monitor_list query `page` (0-based). log_search: page object or cursor size via body. Example: 0.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: monitor_list query `page_size` (1–100). Example: 20.

schema.label: data
schema.description: JSON:API `data` envelope escape hatch for downtime_schedule and incident_create. Purpose fields merge into data.attributes / data.relationships via bodyMap and win on conflict.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Log search filter envelope escape hatch for log_search. Purpose fields query/from/to merge as filter.* via bodyMap.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: log_search body `sort`. Example: -timestamp.

schema.label: date_happened
schema.description: event_post body `date_happened`: POSIX seconds. Defaults to now. Example: 1710000000.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: event_post body `priority`. EXACT: normal | low. Example: normal.

schema.label: host
schema.description: event_post body `host` associated with the event. Example: i-0abc.

schema.label: aggregation_key
schema.description: event_post body `aggregation_key` to group events. Max 100 chars.

schema.label: source_type_name
schema.description: event_post body `source_type_name`. Example: my_apps.

schema.label: type
schema.description: JSON:API resource type nested at data.type. downtime_schedule: downtime. incident_create: incidents. Example: downtime.

schema.label: scope
schema.description: downtime_schedule required data.attributes.scope (monitor search syntax). Example: env:prod.

schema.label: message
schema.description: downtime_schedule data.attributes.message (supports @handles). Example: overnight deploy.

schema.label: monitor_tags
schema.description: downtime_schedule data.attributes.monitor_identifier.monitor_tags. Use ["*"] to mute all monitors in scope. Example: ["*"].

schema.label: display_timezone
schema.description: downtime_schedule data.attributes.display_timezone (IANA). Example: America/New_York.

schema.label: mute_first_recovery_notification
schema.description: downtime_schedule data.attributes.mute_first_recovery_notification. Example: true.

schema.label: notify_end_states
schema.description: downtime_schedule data.attributes.notify_end_states. EXACT values: alert | warn | no data. Example: ["alert","warn"].

schema.label: notify_end_types
schema.description: downtime_schedule data.attributes.notify_end_types. EXACT: expired | canceled. Example: ["expired"].

schema.label: start
schema.description: downtime_schedule one-time schedule.start (ISO-8601 with UTC offset +00:00). Example: 2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00.

schema.label: end
schema.description: downtime_schedule one-time schedule.end (ISO-8601 +00:00). monitor_mute body `end` is POSIX seconds. Example: 2026-11-01T06:00:00+00:00.

schema.label: timezone
schema.description: downtime_schedule schedule.timezone for recurring downtimes (IANA). Example: Europe/Berlin.

schema.label: recurrences
schema.description: downtime_schedule schedule.recurrences: [{start, duration, rrule}]. duration like 24h; rrule e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA,SU.

schema.label: customer_impacted
schema.description: incident_create required data.attributes.customer_impacted. If true, set customer_impact_scope. Example: false.

schema.label: customer_impact_scope
schema.description: incident_create data.attributes.customer_impact_scope. Required when customer_impacted is true.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: incident_create data.attributes.fields: map of field name → {type, value}. Types: dropdown | textbox | multiselect | textarray | metrictag | autocomplete.

schema.label: incident_type_uuid
schema.description: incident_create data.attributes.incident_type_uuid. Default type used when empty.

schema.label: initial_cells
schema.description: incident_create data.attributes.initial_cells (markdown timeline cells).

schema.label: is_test
schema.description: incident_create data.attributes.is_test. Example: false.

schema.label: notification_handles
schema.description: incident_create data.attributes.notification_handles: [{handle, display_name}].

schema.label: commander_user_id
schema.description: incident_create data.relationships.commander_user.data.id (Datadog user id).

schema.label: query
schema.description: log_search filter.query. Datadog log query syntax. Example: service:api status:error.

schema.label: from
schema.description: log_search filter.from. ISO-8601 or now-15m. Example: now-1h.

schema.label: to
schema.description: log_search filter.to. ISO-8601 or now. Example: now.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: metric_submit, event_post, monitor_get, monitor_list, monitor_mute, downtime_schedule, incident_create, incident_get, log_search, listen. monitor_mute is deprecated (prefer downtime_schedule / v2 downtimes). listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Datadog API key (DD-API-KEY). Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Application Key
configurationParameters.description: Datadog application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY). Sent via extraHeaders when set; omitted if blank. Required for most read/management endpoints. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Site
configurationParameters.description: Datadog site host suffix interpolated as https://api.{site}. US: datadoghq.com. EU: datadoghq.eu. Also us3.datadoghq.com, us5.datadoghq.com, ap1.datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu.
